span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A VIP cell inhibits nearby SOM cells, which removes the SOM-mediated blanket inhibition on local pyramidal cells and thereby lets excitation spread through that patch.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The horizontally narrow VIP axon confines the disinhibitory action to a small cylindrical volume of cortex, setting the size of the hole.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: During locomotion many VIPs are recruited at once, so the disinhibition from any single stimulated VIP is swamped and loses its spatial structure.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the problem: SOM, PV and chandelier cells inhibit most or all pyramidal cells within their axonal arbors, which in principle should stop excitation propagating at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the interneuron population looks designed to block both fast and slow excitatory activity, since PV and SOM are driven by fast and slow inputs respectively
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: VIP cells inhibit nearby SOM cells, and SOM cells inhibit pyramidal cells, so activating one VIP opens a local hole in the inhibitory blanket
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: two-photon spiral scanning excites one targeted VIP and not its neighbours, which is what makes single-cell activation possible
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the disinhibitory effect requires concurrent sensory drive - there must be activity for the hole to admit
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: two possible regimes: single VIPs opening tiny patches, or a few nearby VIPs together opening larger ones
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: All recordings came from layer 2/3, so the conclusions do not necessarily hold for deeper layers.
span.note: what this limits: every conclusion in the paper, by layer: AS ALL OUR RECORDINGS WERE FROM LAYER 2/3, THEY ONLY APPLY THERE, and VIPs MAY MEDIATE QUALITATIVELY DIFFERENT EFFECTS IN THE DEEPER LAYERS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Slice measurements of spatial reach may underestimate the true extent because processes are cut.
span.note: what this limits: the spatial-reach measurement: OUR IN VITRO RESULTS MAY BE UNDERESTIMATES DUE TO THE INEVITABILITY OF CUT PROCESSES IN BRAIN SLICES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The correlational in vivo data are directionally ambiguous: nearby cells could be driving the VIPs rather than the reverse.
span.note: what this limits: the direction of the in vivo effect: the results are consistent with VIPs disinhibiting nearby cortex BUT MIGHT EQUALLY ARISE FROM the nearby cells driving the VIPs
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: all recordings are from layer 2/3 and the authors say the conclusions only apply there
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - layer 2/3 only
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: slice results may underestimate the reach because processes are cut
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 1 - cut processes underestimate reach
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the correlational results could equally reflect nearby cells driving the VIPs rather than the reverse, which is why the optogenetic experiment was needed
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[2] · what this limits: the same scope as item 2 - the correlation does not fix the direction
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: during locomotion the spatial structure disappears, attributed to many more VIPs being recruited
span.note: what this limits: the spatial-structure result outside quiescence: DURING LOCOMOTION EPOCHS THE DISTANCE DEPENDENCE WAS SCRAMBLED, attributed to recruitment of many more VIPs
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: six cells were inhibited rather than disinhibited and were set aside as under 1% of the sample
span.note: what this limits: the completeness of the disinhibition account: BECAUSE THE INHIBITED CELLS FORMED <1% OF ALL CELLS, WE DID NOT ANALYZE THEM FURTHER, THOUGH WE NOTE THEY MAY BE SOMS - cells that behaved oppositely were set aside
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the requirement for sensory stimulation is supported by data not shown

This paper's own title is `Opening holes in the blanket of inhibition`, so the received account is the thing it goes on to complicate. · strength of the relation: 0.9 — RE-GROUNDS Karnani2016-opening-holes-in-the-blanket-of-inhibition-l[2]: the old span named ONE endpoint.
